source.name: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team – Aramco (Title Partner page)
source.quote: Aramco is a global integrated energy and chemicals company. It is driven by its core belief that energy is opportunity.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco and Honda celebrate new era at Tokyo partnership launch
source.quote: From the 2026 season onwards, Honda will provide Aston Martin Aramco with power units as a works partner

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco elevates partnership with Maaden as the team's first Principal Partner
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco elevates partnership with Maaden as the team's first Principal Partner

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco announces partnership with Coinbase
source.quote: Coinbase branding will debut on the halo and rear-wing end plate of the AMR25 throughout the season, as well as on drivers Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll's racing suits.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team – Cognizant (partner page)
source.quote: Cognizant, one of the world's leading professional services companies, engineers modern businesses.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – AMF1 Team and Valvoline Global Operations announce strategic partnership
source.quote: Valvoline Global joins AMF1 Team as Official Lubricant Partner ahead of British Grand Prix – celebrated via special one-off livery.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco and NetApp renew data-driven partnership
source.quote: Alongside the extension of the partnership, NetApp become the British team's Global Data Infrastructure Partner.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team – PUMA (partner page)
source.quote: PUMA is one of the world's leading sports brands, designing, developing, selling and marketing footwear, apparel and accessories.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin and Breitling ignite a shared legacy
source.quote: The Breitling logo will be visible on the Aston Martin Aramco car and team apparel from the team's season launch on 9 February

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco announces CoreWeave as Official AI Cloud Computing Partner
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco announces a multi-year partnership with CoreWeave, the first AI Hyperscaler, which joins the team as Official AI Cloud Computing Partner.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Cohere joins Aston Martin Aramco as Official Generative AI Partner to help accelerate AI innovation
source.quote: The partnership establishes Cohere as the Official Generative AI Partner of the Aston Martin Aramco.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco signs AI software engineering specialists, Cognition, in multi-year deal
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team announces a multi-year partnership with Cognition, the dedicated AI coding agent company, which joins as a Global Partner of the Silverstone-based team.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco turns to Eight Sleep to support competitive edge
source.quote: The Eight Sleep logo will appear on the side of the nose at every race, on the driver balaclavas, on the cooling vests worn when needed by drivers and on the handheld cooling fans in the garage.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco and Zscaler redefine speed and security
source.quote: Zscaler branding will debut on the nose, seatbelts and wing mirrors of the AMR26, whilst also being featured on the driver's overalls at the Austrian Grand Prix.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco and CELSIUS enter multi-year global partnership
source.quote: naming CELSIUS an Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Partner and official Global Energy Drink Partner of the team

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco and TikTok renew partnership, bringing 2026 team launch to TikTok LIVE
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team and TikTok announce a renewal of their partnership, marking the next chapter in a collaboration built on a shared ambition to put fans at the centre of Formula One.

source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco announce AQUAME as Official Water Bottle Supplier
source.quote: AQUAME will supply Aston Martin Aramco with their specially designed team water bottle

summary: 2026 Formula One car livery and race suit. Title Partner Aramco (front) and works power-unit partner Honda (front); Principal Partner Ma'aden plus Coinbase, Cognizant, Valvoline, NetApp, PUMA, Breitling, CoreWeave, Cohere, Cognition, Eight Sleep, Zscaler, CELSIUS, TikTok and AQUAME as partners on the car and team apparel.
